### Load DB

## Clonal diversity analysis

### Clonal assignment using the CDR3 as a fingerprint

Note: we will _decrease_ the threshold value by 25% (arbitrarily) in an effort to increase the specificity of the clonal grouping.

```{r}
db <- distToNearest(db, model = "ham", normalize = "len", 
                    vCallColumn = "v_call", 
                    jCallColumn = "j_call",
                    nproc = 4)

# determine the threshold
threshold <- findThreshold(db$dist_nearest, method = "density")
thr <- threshold@threshold

print(thr)
new_thr <- thr - (thr*0.25)
print("25% Lower Threshold:")
print(round(new_thr, 2))
```



```{r}
# Plot histogram of non-NA distances
p1 <- ggplot(data=subset(db, !is.na(dist_nearest))) + 
      theme_bw() + 
      ggtitle("S1 - Distance to nearest: Hamming") + 
      xlab("Hamming distance") +
      geom_histogram(aes(x=dist_nearest), binwidth=0.025, 
                     fill="steelblue", color="white") +
      geom_vline(xintercept = new_thr, linetype="dotted", size = 1, color = "red") #+
      #geom_text(aes(x=thr, label="\nThreshold", y=35000), colour="red", angle=90)

plot(p1)
```

#### We will use the estimated threshold (0.2232809) first

```
docker run -v /Users/emoseley/VHH/data:/data immcantation/suite:4.4.0 \
DefineClones.py -d /data/13_VecF1_R2_S13_parse-select.tsv --vf v_call \
--model ham --norm len --dist 0.22 --format airr --nproc 4 \
--outname 13_VecF1_R2_S13_min_threshold --outdir /data/
```
